description: This file defines the 'Node' class implementing nested set operations for hierarchical data management, including methods for retrieving children and parent nodes, inserting, deleting, and shifting nodes within a nested set structure.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: A class implementing nested set model operations for hierarchy management in database structures, providing methods to navigate, modify, and delete nodes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Node with a NestedSetInterface entity.

methods.name: getLeftValue
methods.description: Retrieves the 'left' value of the node.

methods.name: getRightValue
methods.description: Retrieves the 'right' value of the node.

methods.name: hasChildren
methods.description: Determines if the node has child nodes.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Fetches child nodes up to a specified depth.

methods.name: hasParent
methods.description: Checks if the node has a parent node.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Retrieves the parent node if it exists.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the hierarchy level of the node.

methods.name: insertAsLastChildOf
methods.description: Inserts the current node as the last child of the specified parent node.

methods.name: shiftRlValues
methods.description: Shifts the 'left' and 'right' values of nodes for nested set adjustments.

methods.name: persistNode
methods.description: Persists the node with specified 'left' and 'right' values.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child node to the current node.

methods.name: isLeaf
methods.description: Checks if the node is a leaf node.

methods.name: isRoot
methods.description: Checks if the node is the root of the hierarchy.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the node and its descendants from the hierarchy.
